metadata.name: marco_futures
metadata.description: Marco Valuation Futures — vAMM-settled leveraged futures on private pre-IPO valuations

docs: Marco Valuation Futures.
One market per private company (e.g. Moonshot AI). Traders take
leveraged long/short exposure against a virtual AMM whose price is the
mark; at the real listing/acquisition the admin posts a settlement price
and every position settles at that fixed number. It is a DATED future —
no funding rate.
The program is the counterparty: trader USDC margin lives in a
program-owned collateral vault, and a per-market insurance fund backstops
the residual skew. Two invariants keep that safe — solvency by
construction (never pay out more than a vault holds) and per-market
isolation (margin, reserves and insurance never cross markets).

instructions.name: close_position
docs: Close or reduce a position against the vAMM. `base_amount` is the base
to close (0 == close all); `limit_price` (1e6, 0 to skip) bounds the
average fill. Realized PnL settles into margin; a full close pays the
remaining margin back to the trader. Holder-signed.

instructions.name: create_market
docs: Create a valuation-futures market. Seeds the vAMM so the mark equals
the anchor valuation, and opens the collateral and insurance vaults.
PDA seeds: [b"market", config, market_id]. Admin only.

accounts.name: collateral_vault
docs: Program-owned USDC account holding all trader margin for this market.

accounts.name: insurance_vault
docs: Program-owned USDC account backstopping this market.

instructions.name: deposit_collateral
docs: Deposit USDC margin into the caller's position (created on first
deposit). Holder-signed.

instructions.name: halt_market
docs: Halt or resume a single market (blocks new opens on it). Admin only.

instructions.name: initialize
docs: Create the protocol config. PDA seeds: [b"config"]. Admin only,
once per deployment.

accounts.name: usdc_mint
docs: The collateral mint every market will accept (USDC, 6 decimals).

instructions.name: liquidate_position
docs: Liquidate an under-collateralised position at the vAMM. Permissionless
keeper: callable once equity, marked at the vAMM, falls below the
maintenance margin. Pays the liquidator a reward and returns any
residual equity to the owner; the insurance fund covers a deficit.

accounts.name: owner_usdc
docs: The owner's USDC account, to receive any residual equity.

accounts.name: liquidator_usdc
docs: The liquidator's USDC account, to receive the keeper reward.

instructions.name: open_position
docs: Open or increase a leveraged position against the vAMM. `notional` is
the USDC exposure to add; `limit_price` (1e6, 0 to skip) bounds the
average fill. Holder-signed.

instructions.name: pause
docs: Flip the protocol-wide pause (blocks new opens everywhere). Admin only.

instructions.name: seed_insurance
docs: Fund a market's insurance vault with USDC. Permissionless — anyone can
strengthen the backstop.

instructions.name: set_operator
docs: Rotate the operator (keeper) wallet. Admin only.

instructions.name: settle_market
docs: Post the final valuation at the real listing/acquisition and move the
market to Settled. Admin or operator only.

instructions.name: settle_position
docs: Settle one position at the market's final price and pay the owner.
Permissionless; PnL is computed at the fixed settlement price.

instructions.name: withdraw_collateral
docs: Withdraw free USDC margin — the amount above the position's initial
margin requirement. Holder-signed.

types.name: CollateralDeposited
docs: Events for the holder-initiated instructions, mirroring the vault program's
convention: the off-chain orchestrator builds every intent from an observed
chain event rather than an HTTP call, so each event carries enough to act on
without re-reading account state. `market_id` rides alongside the market
pubkey because the orchestrator keys markets by that string.
Admin transitions (initialize, create_market, halt, settle_market) are not
emitted — the operator submits those and already knows they happened.
Liquidation IS emitted: it can be triggered permissionlessly by a third
party, so it arrives at the orchestrator unannounced otherwise.
A trader added USDC margin to their position.

types.name: CollateralWithdrawn
docs: A trader withdrew free USDC margin from their position.

types.name: FuturesConfig
docs: Protocol-global config. One per deployment. Holds the authorities and
the collateral mint; per-market economics (fees, leverage, margin) live
on each `Market`, seeded from `create_market` params.

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump. Seeds: [b"config"].

fields.name: admin
docs: Controlling authority — expected to be a Squads multisig PDA. Can
create markets, halt, settle, and rotate the operator.

fields.name: operator
docs: Operator wallet — the off-chain keeper. May settle and run
liquidations; cannot move funds to itself (can equal admin).

fields.name: treasury
docs: Treasury wallet — reserved for future fee sweeps. In v1 all trading
fees seed the per-market insurance fund instead.

fields.name: usdc_mint
docs: The one collateral mint every market accepts (USDC, 6 decimals).

fields.name: paused
docs: Emergency kill-switch. When true, no market accepts new opens.

fields.name: market_count
docs: Number of markets created (monotonic; informational).

fields.name: _reserved
docs: Reserved for forward-compatible upgrades.

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump. Seeds: [b"market", config, market_id].

fields.name: config
docs: Back-reference to the owning `FuturesConfig`.

fields.name: market_id
docs: Human-readable id, e.g. "moon-2026". Max 32 bytes.

fields.name: usdc_mint
docs: Collateral mint (USDC), copied from config for local validation.

fields.name: collateral_vault
docs: Program-owned USDC account holding ALL trader margin for this market.
Owned by the market PDA; only this program can move funds out.

fields.name: insurance_vault
docs: Program-owned USDC account backstopping this market. Seeded by
`seed_insurance` and fed by trading fees; drawn on to cover payouts
the collateral vault alone cannot.

fields.name: status
docs: Lifecycle status.

fields.name: base_reserve
docs: Virtual base reserve (signed exposure denominated in base units,
same 1e6 scale as a price of 1.0). Falls as the pool goes net-long.

fields.name: quote_reserve
docs: Virtual quote reserve (USDC-equivalent depth). Rises as the pool
takes in long notional. Mark price == quote_reserve / base_reserve.

fields.name: initial_base_reserve
docs: Reserves at creation, retained so net trader exposure and the
distance travelled from the anchor can be read back.

fields.name: anchor_price
docs: The seed valuation index (1e6). Mark price equals this at creation.

fields.name: max_leverage
docs: Maximum leverage, e.g. 3 == 3x. Initial margin ratio == 1 / max_leverage.

fields.name: maintenance_margin_bps
docs: Maintenance margin ratio in bps, e.g. 625 == 6.25%. Below this a
position is liquidatable.

fields.name: taker_fee_bps
docs: Taker fee in bps charged on notional at open and close, e.g. 30 == 0.30%.
In v1 the whole fee is routed to the insurance vault.

fields.name: liquidation_fee_bps
docs: Liquidation penalty in bps of the liquidated notional, split between
the liquidator (keeper reward) and the insurance vault.

fields.name: max_oi_notional
docs: Cap on the open notional per side (long and short each). 0 == no cap.

fields.name: long_open_notional
docs: Sum of `open_notional` across open long positions.

fields.name: short_open_notional
docs: Sum of `open_notional` across open short positions.

fields.name: total_collateral
docs: Sum of `margin` across all open positions (accounting mirror; the
collateral vault balance is the source of truth for solvency).

fields.name: position_count
docs: Open positions in this market (informational).

fields.name: settlement_price
docs: Final settlement price (1e6), 0 until the market is Settled.

fields.name: expiry_ts
docs: Informational expected-listing timestamp / dated-expiry fallback.

fields.name: settled_at
docs: When the market settled (0 until then).

fields.name: created_at
docs: When the market was created.

fields.name: _reserved
docs: Reserved for forward-compatible upgrades.

types.name: MarketParams
docs: All market parameters, frozen at creation. `quote_reserve` sets the vAMM's
depth (in USDC-equivalent units); the base reserve is derived so the mark
price equals `anchor_price` exactly at launch.

fields.name: anchor_price
docs: Seed valuation index (1e6). e.g. a $12.5B anchor is 12_500_000.

fields.name: quote_reserve
docs: vAMM quote-reserve depth (USDC-equivalent). Larger == less slippage.

fields.name: max_leverage
docs: Max leverage, e.g. 3 == 3x.

fields.name: maintenance_margin_bps
docs: Maintenance margin ratio in bps (must be below the initial ratio).

fields.name: taker_fee_bps
docs: Taker fee in bps on notional, charged at open and close.

fields.name: liquidation_fee_bps
docs: Liquidation penalty in bps of liquidated notional.

fields.name: max_oi_notional
docs: Per-side open-interest cap in USDC notional (0 == uncapped).

fields.name: expiry_ts
docs: Informational expected-listing timestamp / dated-expiry fallback.

types.name: MarketSettled
docs: The market settled: the admin/operator posted the final valuation. No more
trading; holders settle each position at `settlement_price`.

types.name: MarketStatus
docs: The lifecycle of a single valuation-futures market.

types.name: Position
docs: One trader's isolated position in one market. Isolated margin: the
`margin` here backs only this position and nothing else. A trader holds
at most one open position per market; increasing adds to it, closing
reduces it, and flipping sides requires a full close first.

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump. Seeds: [b"position", market, owner].

fields.name: market
docs: The market this position trades.

fields.name: owner
docs: The position owner (holder wallet).

fields.name: margin
docs: USDC collateral committed to this position (6dp). Deposits raise it,
withdrawals and fees lower it, realized losses consume it and realized
profits are paid out of the collateral vault (not added here).

fields.name: base_size
docs: Net base exposure (signed: +long, -short). Same 1e6 scale as price.

fields.name: open_notional
docs: Cost basis: cumulative quote (USDC) swapped to build `base_size`.
For a long this is USDC paid in; for a short, USDC received. PnL is
measured against this.

fields.name: realized_pnl
docs: Lifetime realized PnL for this position (signed), for reporting.

fields.name: last_updated
docs: Unix ts of the last mutation.

fields.name: _reserved
docs: Reserved for forward-compatible upgrades.

types.name: PositionClosed
docs: A trader closed or reduced a position against the vAMM.

fields.name: base_delta
docs: Base closed on this fill (absolute value).

fields.name: realized_pnl
docs: Realized PnL on the closed portion (signed, USDC 6dp).

fields.name: fee
docs: Taker fee routed to the insurance vault.

fields.name: payout
docs: USDC paid out to the trader on this close (0 if none was free).

fields.name: mark_price
docs: vAMM mark price after the fill (1e6).

fields.name: base_size_after
docs: Position base size after the fill (signed; 0 when fully closed).

types.name: PositionLiquidated
docs: A position was liquidated (permissionless keeper). The whole position is
closed at the vAMM; `reward` goes to the liquidator, any remaining equity
to the owner, and `insurance_cover` is drawn from the insurance fund to
make the pool whole when the position closed underwater (`bad_debt`).

fields.name: base_closed
docs: Base closed (absolute value; always the full position).

fields.name: realized_pnl
docs: Realized PnL at liquidation (signed, USDC 6dp).

fields.name: reward
docs: Keeper reward paid to the liquidator.

fields.name: trader_refund
docs: Residual equity returned to the owner (0 when underwater).

fields.name: bad_debt
docs: Equity deficit past the owner's margin (0 when solvent).

fields.name: insurance_cover
docs: USDC drawn from the insurance fund to cover the deficit.

fields.name: mark_price
docs: The mark that triggered the liquidation (1e6).

types.name: PositionOpened
docs: A trader opened or increased a position against the vAMM.

fields.name: is_long
docs: True for a long, false for a short.

fields.name: notional
docs: USDC notional swapped in on this fill.

fields.name: base_delta
docs: Base acquired on this fill (absolute value).

fields.name: fee
docs: Taker fee taken from margin and routed to the insurance vault.

fields.name: mark_price
docs: vAMM mark price after the fill (1e6).

fields.name: base_size_after
docs: Position base size after the fill (signed).

types.name: PositionSettled
docs: A holder's position settled at the market's final price.

fields.name: realized_pnl
docs: Realized PnL at the settlement price (signed, USDC 6dp).

fields.name: payout
docs: USDC paid out to the owner.

fields.name: insurance_draw
docs: USDC drawn from the insurance fund to fund the payout.
